purpose: Seeded, dual-engine Go/Rust transaction differential fixtures for the seven database-transaction routes in route-compatibility-matrix.tsv.

isolation.legacy: fresh SQLite database beneath the harness mktemp directory
isolation.rust: fresh PostgreSQL 18 database and dedicated test schema beneath the harness mktemp directory

normalization: generated access tokens, timestamps, and log ids are compared by shape or omitted from row snapshots
post-commit cache/log effects are observed separately and never make a committed database transaction appear rolled back

positive.expect: one nonempty generated access_token for user 101

rollback.inject: unique access_token collision on generated candidate
rollback.expect: request fails and prior access_token remains unchanged

replay.expect: a replacement access_token is generated; previous token is not retained

positive.seed: enabled checkin setting and one historical August record
positive.expect: returns aggregate status without changing users or checkins

failure.expect: legacy disabled message and users/checkins unchanged

rollback.expect: legacy system-error response and unchanged snapshot

replay.expect: same normalized body and identical users/checkins snapshot

positive.seed: enabled fixed-award setting, user 101 quota 100, no checkin today
positive.expect: one today checkin and user quota 100 plus award

failure.expect: already-checked-in response and no additional quota/checkin row

rollback.inject: abort users quota UPDATE after checkin INSERT
rollback.expect: failed checkin with users and checkins unchanged

replay.expect: second call fails already-checked-in; only one award is durable

positive.seed: compliance enabled; user 101 quota 100 and aff_quota 500000
positive.expect: quota increases by 500000 and aff_quota becomes zero

failure.expect: insufficient-affiliate-quota response and user row unchanged

rollback.expect: transfer failure and both quota columns unchanged

replay.expect: second call fails insufficient balance; transfer is applied exactly once

positive.seed: USD display options, enabled payment option, user 101 default group

failure.expect: legacy minimum-amount error and no writes

rollback.expect: legacy calculation failure and unchanged users/options snapshot

replay.expect: same normalized quote and no durable effects

positive.seed: compliance enabled; enabled redemption key grants 300; user 101 quota 100
positive.expect: redemption becomes used by 101 and user quota becomes 400

failure.expect: generic redeem failure and no quota credit

rollback.inject: abort users quota UPDATE after redemption status CAS
rollback.expect: generic redeem failure; redemptions and users unchanged

replay.expect: second call fails and only one 300-quota credit is durable

positive.seed: pending manual topup for user 101 with deterministic quota-per-unit
positive.expect: topup status becomes success and user 101 gains calculated quota

rollback.inject: abort users quota UPDATE after topup status UPDATE
rollback.expect: system error; topup remains pending and user quota unchanged

replay.expect: success response is retained but quota is not credited twice
